title: TRAIL-IRL: Crossed Reward-Temperature Mixtures for Unlabeled Trajectory Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.22715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Different paths need not imply different preferences, trajectories also differ in how randomly actions are chosen. Many multi-reward inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) methods assume common action randomness and can confound it with preference heterogeneity. We introduce TRAIL-IRL, which clusters unlabeled trajectories using rewards for preferences and temperatures for action randomness. Its crossed mixture pairs each reward with a shared set of temperature levels, allowing action regularity to vary within preference groups. With centered and normalized rewards in a known finite-state environment, we establish the identifiability conditions under which the distribution of sufficiently long trajectories determines rewards, temperatures, mixing weights, and class counts up to relabeling. Under the same conditions and reward constraints, common-temperature reward mixtures with the same component count cannot reproduce a crossed mixture

translated_title: TRAIL-IRL：用于无标签轨迹聚类的奖励-温度交叉混合模型
translated_abstract: 不同的路径并不一定意味着不同的偏好，轨迹在动作选择的随机性程度上同样存在差异。许多多奖励逆强化学习（IRL）方法假设动作随机性是共同的，这可能会将其与偏好异质性相混淆。我们提出了TRAIL-IRL，该方法使用奖励来刻画偏好，使用温度来刻画动作随机性，从而对无标签轨迹进行聚类。其交叉混合模型将每个奖励与一组共享的温度水平配对，允许动作规律性在偏好组内部发生变化。在已知有限状态环境中使用中心化和归一化的奖励，我们建立了可辨识性条件，在这些条件下，足够长的轨迹分布能够确定奖励、温度、混合权重以及类别数量（在标签重排的意义下）。在相同的条件和奖励约束下，具有相同分量数量的共同温度奖励混合模型无法重现交叉混合模型。
tldr: 该论文提出TRAIL-IRL方法，通过将奖励（表示偏好）与共享温度集合（表示动作随机性）交叉配对的混合模型对无标签轨迹进行聚类，建立了该模型的可辨识性条件，并证明传统的共同温度奖励混合模型无法重现这种交叉混合结构。
en_tdlr: TRAIL-IRL clusters unlabeled trajectories via crossed reward-temperature mixtures that disentangle preferences (rewards) from action randomness (temperatures), establishing identifiability conditions and proving that common-temperature reward mixtures cannot reproduce such crossed mixtures.
